_note: The first few minutes of a new game. Each step shows one line next to the thing to press ('go' instead while it points at the tab to get there first), and moves on by itself once it's done. 'speaker' is who says it: 'box' (the pet still inside a box), 'pets' (both new pets), 'active' (your new active pet; {active} and {other} are filled in). 'box_talk' is what the pet inside says while you open a box during the tutorial (first box, second box); outside the tutorial boxes don't talk.

steps.speaker: box
steps.say: psst… over here! something's wiggling in this box!

steps.speaker: box
steps.say: me too! me too! i'm in this one!

steps.speaker: pets
steps.go: tap here to see your pets!
steps.say: pick me! no, pick me! (tap a pet, then make it your active pet ♡)

steps.speaker: active
steps.go: tap here to go on an adventure!
steps.say: i'll stay home with you! let's send {other} down the garden path! ♡

box_talk: it's dark in here! rip the top off! ♡
me too! let me out too!
